rule: Frozen before any VM exists. Each workload is a pure Book whose main returns True{} exactly when its independent guard holds; a VM run must print Evaluated\t<index of the pinned Bool in the image>\t1\tTrue{}. Sources must not change; a new size is a new workload.

workloads.name: peano
workloads.shape: Unary Peano add/mul on a user datatype: 200 rounds of count(mul(1000,1000)), each building and consuming 10^6 S cells.

workloads.name: cps-choose
workloads.shape: Lexer-shaped CPS closure churn: src/lex.bend normal's chain of choose(Result<...>) calls, two closures per link, 8 passes over 50,000 copies of a 22-character line (1.1M characters per pass).
workloads.guard: closed form: each pass finds 4 words and 1 line per copy (200000 words, 50000 lines); 8 passing verdicts

workloads.name: string-scan
workloads.shape: Char-list String building and String.eq scans: 900 rounds each build a fresh 10,000-character SCon string and compare it with a fixed one.
workloads.guard: closed form: every round compares equal strings: 900 hits

workloads.name: list-fold
workloads.shape: List<U32> build and fold: 240 rounds of building 1..1000000 and summing it modulo 2^32.

workloads.name: deep-recursion
workloads.shape: Deep non-tail recursion: 4000 rounds of depth(250000n), each holding 250,000 pending U32.add frames.

workloads.name: sha256-64k
workloads.shape: SHA-256 over 65,536 ASCII bytes ('a' + i mod 26) with modules' base-pin.bend compression function (U32.xor/or/and/not, shifts).
workloads.guard: hashlib.sha256(bytes(97 + i % 26 for i in range(65536))) = 62b3a2ef06cf977623a5936a8fa653e3caecbf69b5f393ebdfe5022affc5331f

measurements.rule: The committed seed-native measurements are frozen with the sources. run.py re-measures and rewrites both files; a re-measurement is adopted only by re-pinning these digests in a reviewed commit.
